snippet.title: Odyssey - The Next Generation Science Game Teaser
snippet.description: Odyssey is a science education game produced by The Young Socratics. Covering the development of astronomy and mechanics from the ancient Greeks to Newton, it combines a historical-philosophical approach to science with a first-person exploration game environment and an adventure story. For more information please visit http://theodysseygame.com
